Alger, 20 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 20, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Djezzy and Algerian startup BortoCall unveil Relay, a secure professional messaging platform hosted in Algeria, available in SaaS mode via the operator's Marketplace. The solution meets the confidentiality and digital sovereignty requirements of local organizations.
Djezzy et BortoCall unissent leurs force: Djezzy and BortoCall join forces for sovereign professional messaging in Algeria
Djezzy et BortoCall, startup algérienne: Djezzy and BortoCall, an Algerian startup specializing in communication solutions, announce the commercial launch of Relay by BortoCall, a professional instant messaging and collaboration solution. Developed for Algerian businesses, government bodies, and institutions, this platform relies on end-to-end encryption and a 100% local hosting infrastructure via Djezzy Cloud.
Disponible sur la Marketplace de Djezzy,: Available on the Djezzy Marketplace, Relay targets organizations of all sizes, with modular offerings tailored to their needs. The solution allows employees to communicate via individual or group messaging, make audio/video calls, share files, and create dedicated channels for teams or projects. A key feature also allows the creation of inter-organizational networks, facilitating secure professional exchanges.
Pour renforcer la gestion centralisée, R: To enhance centralized management, Relay integrates an administration console enabling IT managers to oversee users, access, licenses, and permissions, in accordance with the internal policies of each structure.
Un cadre juridique et technique adapté a: A legal and technical framework tailored to Algerian requirements Hosting data on Djezzy Cloud ensures its processing and storage in Algeria, in compliance with local regulations on personal data protection. This sovereign approach addresses the growing challenges of communication security, data protection, and digital control, which are priorities for the country's economic and institutional stakeholders.
Un partenariat stratégique pour l’innova: A strategic partnership for local innovation
À l’occasion du lancement, Bilal Sefsaf,: At the launch, Bilal Sefsaf, CEO and co-founder of BortoCall, emphasizes the importance of placing confidentiality and data protection at the heart of technological solutions. "Relay was designed to offer businesses an environment where their communications are secure and their data is under control, with end-to-end encryption and 100% Algerian hosting," he explains. He adds that this partnership with Djezzy marks a key milestone in making this technology accessible to Algerian organizations while strengthening the national tech ecosystem.
De son côté, Boumediene Senouci, Directe: Meanwhile, Boumediene Senouci, CEO of Djezzy, highlights the operator's ambition to support the digital transformation of local businesses. "Relay illustrates our commitment to providing innovative solutions aligned with the current needs of organizations while ensuring security and sovereignty," he states.
